exact_bodies_read.head: 38ce77a4925c18eb66f94634b1b11a1242af8a87
exact_bodies_read.title: Prove production Gaussian positivity and retained matrix perturbation
exact_bodies_read.scope:
The physical Gaussian producer's scalar enclosure left denominator positivity and actual original-coordinate matrix composition open. This package proves those implications for every admitted ProductionPlan/Axis layout tuple, conditional on the scalar theorem in #6085 at `9fc80f1db55d4939c7b53c0799e6840cce35fbf8`.

The guards give `a_hat_j > 2^(-8p-1)` and the unchanged `Axis.matrix_entry` consumer satisfies `||H-N_w||_infinity < p*2^(16p+4)*eta`, stronger than the requested `p*2^(16p+7)*eta`. The proof handles exact diagonal, zero holes, same-cell ratios, cross-cell coefficients and physical-period cuts. `N_w` is explicitly the ideal truncated matrix using the source's displacement convention.

exact_bodies_read.head: 1ea9efdc1d1d36757a5491bf7fdaa93597dcea67
exact_bodies_read.title: Prove weighted periodic Gaussian power bound and reduce complete inverse to120 terms
exact_bodies_read.scope:
The original complete periodic Gaussian inverse service used276 terms because its tail estimate inherited the small scalar row gap. This contribution proves a source-compatible diagonal majorant for the actual rational reference across shared ratios, cross-cell entries, period crossings and holes. The weighted contraction is independent of theta, while its exponential gauge prefactor remains explicit.

On the unchanged `Reference(384,1,2,4,18,320)`, the complete action now uses120 terms/119 updates on the same33-bit grid, down from276 terms/275 updates. The full385-row output, numerical rounding, coefficient error, inherited analytic perturbation, setup caches, output ownership and cleanup remain funded. The new trajectory performs731,136 integer products and91,630 component roundings. This is a host-array consumer saving, not a physical tape, production-family or multiplication-bound claim.

exact_bodies_read.head: efa89adc2c71f1ef57228111639e1c8fc48393e3
exact_bodies_read.title: Count all joint capacity ranks with fixed-image quotient compression
exact_bodies_read.scope:
Arbitrary simultaneous source/capacity inclusions now have an exact finite-field completion reference. It counts matrices of **every rank**, constructs an isomorphism when one exists, and otherwise constructs an exact maximum-rank witness. Targets may overlap, repeat or be nonnested. This answers the general finite-field count obligation left open by [PR6489](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6489).

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/efa89adc2c71f1ef57228111639e1c8fc48393e3/research/nonnested-capacity-rank-count/PROOF.md) compiles the full joint contract into affine equations, counts solutions that kill each kernel subspace, and inverts the resulting triangular Gaussian-binomial system. These counting tools are classical. The new repository application includes exact maximum-rank construction and **fixed-injection quotient compression**. Fixing u independent directions reduces the kernel lattice from dimension n to n-u while retaining every coupling to the fixed image space. In the 12-dimensional fixture with ten fixed directions, this uses five subspaces instead of 488,176,700,923. This is an exact inventory comparison, not a timing claim.
